checks: Native storage → reload → fresh browser-process restart → source-locked keyboard recovery → save → portable export
Delayed native draft acknowledgment coalesces newer input; explicit discard waits for the writer
Discard during an in-flight native write waits for its acknowledgment and cannot resurrect on reload
Navigation during native persistence retains original identity and requires explicit recovery after reload
Concurrent recovery uses draft versions; losing edits export, stale discard cannot delete winning text
Refresh and restart cannot rebase stale edits; separate-note recovery preserves newer notes; deleted notes stay deleted
Real local-storage quota exhaustion preserves saved notes and last acknowledged draft; pending text exports and retries
Failed recovery read leaves the composer closed and stored draft intact
Failed post-save cleanup retains a recovery copy and identifies already-saved content without duplication
32-draft bound rejects extra persistence without eviction; old drafts remain listed and usable at 320px
Recovered saved notes retain the existing portable notebook format in a fresh profile
limitations: Synthetic bundled pages; no live provider or human screen-reader testing.
Latency includes debounce, IPC, native storage and Playwright scheduling.
Fresh-process restart is graceful; hardware crash durability is not tested.
